resCmpData.re_desc_note_fin: 1. Presently there is no Independent Director on the Board of the Company. The Company has reconstituted the Audit Committee comprising of 3 whole time Directors. However, as per Corporate Governance norms presence of requisite number of Independent Directors is required to form the quorum. In the absence of same, Standalone Financial Results for the quarter and nine months ended 31st December, 2024 were reviewed and approved by the Board of Directors in their meeting held on 10th February 2025.   2. These financial results have been prepared in accordance with Indian Accounting Standards (Ind AS) as prescribed under section 133 of the Companies Act, 2013 read with Rule 3 of the Companies (Indian Accounting Standards) Rules, 2015 and relevant amendment rules thereafter.   3. Other Income for the nine months ended 31st December, 2023 and year ended 31st March, 2024 includes interest income to the tune of Rs 5,561.30 lakhs pursuant to settlement with Client in Consultancy and Engineering Project segment.   4. In the nine months ended 31st December, 2023 and year ended 31st March, 2024, in one of the turnkey project executed by the company, there was settlement with respect to liquidated damages deducted by the Client and accordingly revenue & profit from turnkey projects includes an amount of Rs 4,489.67 lakhs and Rs 4,457.53 lakhs respectively towards said settlement.   5. The Auditors of the Company have carried out  Limited Review  of the above financial results for the quarter and nine months ended 31st December, 2024.   6. The Board of Directors have declared an interim dividend of Rs 2/-per Share (Face Value of Rs 5 per share ) for the financial year 2024-25 in their meeting held on 10th February 2025.
